WITH detail_list AS ( /* 삭제 건 제외한 리스트 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAY00019.retireveValidateUserDefineTableValueData */ row_no , column_seq_no , table_cell_id , table_cell_value , effective_start_yyyymmdd , effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM tb_pay_user_dfin_table_value_n WHERE row_no = #{parameter.rowNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND column_seq_no = #{parameter.columnSeqNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 삭제건이 있는 경우 제외 처리 */ AND table_cell_id NOT IN SELECT #{deleteItem.tableCellId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS table_cell_id FROM dual ) , rs AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(#{parameter.rowNo}) AS row_no , TO_NUMBER(#{parameter.columnSeqNo}) AS column_seq_no , TO_NUMBER(#{createItem.tableCellId}) AS table_cell_id , #{createItem.tableCellValue} AS table_cell_value , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{createItem.effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{createItem.effectiveEndYyyymmdd} , 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM dual UNION ALL /* 신규건이 있는 경우 기존데이터와 union하기 위해 union 함 */ SELECT NVL(update_list.row_no , detail_list.row_no ) AS row_no , NVL(update_list.column_seq_no , detail_list.column_seq_no ) AS column_seq_no , NVL(update_list.table_cell_id , detail_list.table_cell_id ) AS table_cell_id , NVL(update_list.table_cell_value , detail_list.table_cell_value ) AS table_cell_value , NVL(update_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd, detail_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd) AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , NVL(update_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd , detail_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd ) AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM detail_list , ( /* 수정건이 있는 경우 Detail 항목 리스트와 outer join 하여 등록된 최종 Detail 리스트를 조회한다 */ SELECT TO_NUMBER(#{parameter.rowNo}) AS row_no , TO_NUMBER(#{parameter.columnSeqNo}) AS column_seq_no , #{updated[${idx}].tableCellId} AS table_cell_id , #{updated[${idx}].tableCellValue} AS table_cell_value , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{updated[${idx}].effectiveStartYyyymmdd} , 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{updated[${idx}].effectiveEndYyyymmdd} , 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM dual ) update_list WHERE detail_list.row_no = update_list.row_no(+) AND detail_list.column_seq_no = update_list.column_seq_no(+) AND detail_list.table_cell_id = update_list.table_cell_id(+) SELECT detail_list.row_no , detail_list.column_seq_no , detail_list.table_cell_id , detail_list.table_cell_value , detail_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd , detail_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM detail_list ) SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT listagg(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) FROM rs , tb_pay_user_dfin_table_row_n udtr WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM rs rs0 WHERE rs0.row_no = rs.row_no AND rs0.column_seq_no = rs.column_seq_no AND rs0.effective_start_yyyymmdd = rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd GROUP BY rs0.effective_start_yyyymmdd HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) AND udtr.row_no = rs.row_no GROUP BY rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd) AS dup_start_date /* Effective Start Date 중복 */ ,(SELECT DISTINCT listagg(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) FROM rs WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM rs rs0 WHERE rs0.row_no = rs.row_no AND rs0.column_seq_no = rs.column_seq_no /* 시작일 또는 종료일이 기간내에 포함된 경우 */ AND (rs0.effective_start_yyyymmdd BETWEEN rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd AND rs.effective_end_yyyymmdd OR rs0.effective_end_yyyymmdd BETWEEN rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd AND rs.effective_end_yyyymmdd) GROUP BY rs0.row_no, rs0.column_seq_no HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) GROUP BY rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd) AS dup_period /* Effective Start Date, Effective End Date 기간 중복 */ ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'EffectiveStartDate' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_start_date_title FROM dual
mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAY00019.insertUserDefineTableValue */ INTO tb_pay_user_dfin_table_value_n( table_cell_id /* 테이블셀아이디 */ , row_no /* 로우번호 */ , column_seq_no /* 컬럼일련순서번호 */ , table_cell_value /* 테이블셀문자값 */ , effective_start_yyyymmdd /* 유효시작년월일 */ , effective_end_yyyymmdd /* 유효종료년월일 */ , creation_date /* 생성일자 */ , creation_user_id /* 생성사용자아이디 */ , last_update_date /* 최종수정일자 */ , last_update_user_id /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ ) VALUES ( sq_tb_pay_user_df_tab_value_n.nextval /* table_cell_id => 테이블셀아이디 */ , #{rowNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* row_no => 로우번호 */ , #{columnSeqNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* column_seq_no => 컬럼일련순서번호 */ , #{tableCellValue} /* table_cell_value => 테이블셀문자값 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* effective_start_yyyymmdd => 유효시작년월일 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveEndYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* effective_end_yyyymmdd => 유효종료년월일 */ , SYSDATE /* creation_date => 생성일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* creation_user_id => 생성사용자아이디 */ , SYSDATE /* last_update_date => 최종수정일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* last_update_user_id => 최종수정사용자아이디 */ )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAY00019.updateUserDefineTableValue */ tb_pay_user_dfin_table_value_n SET table_cell_value = #{tableCellValue} /* 테이블셀문자값 */ , effective_start_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* 유효시작년월일 */ , effective_end_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveEndYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* 유효종료년월일 */ , last_update_date = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일자 */ , last_update_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ WHERE table_cell_id = #{tableCellId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 테이블셀아이디 */
